search_log: Repository code/contracts/test inventory before generic public retrieval; OpenAI Docs used for Codex official interfaces.
First source wave: Codex/Claude/Cursor/OpenCode programmatic controls and extension mechanisms; Anthropic billing versus distribution reconciliation.
Owner steering expanded focused wave to Gemini, Hermes Agent, Grok Build/xAI, Muse Code, DeepSeek Harness and T3 composition.
Mechanism wave: CUE, WASI, FoundationDB simulation, Temporal and DBOS compared as candidates; no framework selection.

Stopped after each named integration had primary mechanism evidence or explicit access/technical gap and a decisive next probe. Exact builds, execution and eligibility remain unverified; this is preparation, not exhaustive certification.
limitations: No live provider, account, plugin, host or runtime probe was executed.
Mutable main/docs are source locators, not immutable implementation pins. The next matrix must bind build/schema/config/host and observations.
All reasoning roles must use admitted route bindings; unknown consumption is null/unavailable, never zero.
Native provider coverage must split into concrete OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Meta, OpenRouter/other gateway and local routes before admission; no generic native row is executable.
Search/retrieval failures do not establish product absence. Meta developer access limits are recorded; no login workaround attempted.
